trigger_conditions: Any frozen v0.04 mandatory gate fails or becomes blocked.
Frozen corpus, evaluation plan, or release contract integrity fails.
Historical release evidence cannot be verified without rewriting prior history.
procedure: Keep the complete v0.04 candidate directory and evaluation evidence as failed or superseded history.
Restore v0.03 as the active promoted-experimental executable baseline.
Do not alter v0.03 frozen contract, manifest, release snapshots, regression records, or raw v0.04 failure events.
Create a governed successor/retry contract rather than weakening REL-0.04-FROZEN-001.
data_loss_expectation: None. Candidate artifacts remain preserved for audit and regression extraction.
